name: Floor Ratio Asymmetry
description: Replaces the determinant-based inequality check with a non-linear algebraic condition involving floor division ($\lfloor p_u / p_v \rfloor \neq \lfloor p_v / p_u \rfloor$). This obscures the simple $p_u \neq p_v$ logic. While mathematically equivalent over the domain {1,2,3}, it prevents pattern-matching models from immediately identifying the problem as Graph 3-Coloring, forcing them to deduce the equivalence or evaluate the condition dynamically, which can disrupt standard graph-heuristic applications like degree-sorting.
